notes.title: Additions and Fixes
notes.content:
This update includes the following changes:

- small bug fixes in several levels of the game.
- minor performance optimizations for a few levels.
- added controls tutorial for level 15.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Escape Underground just received a big update with colored graphics and better player control!

List of changes:

[b]- mobile friendly UI
- the game now has a colored mode that is set to default
- player coyote jump
- player jump strenght and fall speed adjusted
- player can now do ledge grab and ceiling climb in certain places
- jumping between platforms doesn't require much precision anymore
- every level has received small modifications[/b]

I encourage you to play the new version of the game.

Enjoy!
